title: Beat title
description: A title screen for a music game or a high-energy intro: stacked display words with a neon split that kicks on the beat, an equalizer along the bottom and notes drifting up, all at a tempo. Drops in word by word, then keeps moving while an interactive scene waits for input (it runs on f.ui.now). Takes a theme.

title.description: One word per line (\n breaks a line)

subtitle.default: A rhythm game you play in the browser

top.description: Where the title starts, as a share of the height

sun.description: Radius of the sun on the horizon, % of the short side of the frame (0: none)

horizon.description: Where the horizon (the sun, the grid floor) sits, as a share of the height

size.description: Line height of the title, % of the frame's short side
